Import a theme from a shadcn / tweakcn registry export

Source: R/theme.R
shad_theme_from_registry.Rd

Experimental. Convert a shadcn registry item or tweakcn theme export (its cssVars blocks) into a shad_theme(), mapping upstream variable names to shadshiny tokens via the bundled theme map. Unmapped variables are skipped with a single warning.

Usage

shad_theme_from_registry(json)

Arguments

json

A file path, URL, or JSON string of a registry/tweakcn export.

Value

A shad_theme object.

See also

Other shadshiny theming: shad_chart_colors(), shad_current_theme(), shad_theme(), shad_theme_echarts4r(), shad_theme_ggplot2(), shad_theme_plotly(), shad_theme_scope(), shad_tokens()

Examples

# A registry export as JSON text; a file path or URL works too.
registry <- '{"cssVars": {
  "light": {"--primary": "oklch(0.6 0.2 250)", "--radius": "0.5rem"},
  "dark": {"--primary": "oklch(0.7 0.2 250)"}
}}'
shad_theme_from_registry(registry)
#> $tokens
#> $tokens$primary
#> [1] "oklch(0.6 0.2 250)"
#> 
#> $tokens$radius
#> [1] "0.5rem"
#> 
#> 
#> $dark
#> $tokens
#> $tokens$primary
#> [1] "oklch(0.7 0.2 250)"
#> 
#> 
#> $dark
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_theme"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_theme"
